projects.title: Taipei International Architecture Firm (台北國際聯合建築師事務所) — 彰化銀行建城分行 & Revit BIM
projects.subtitle: Chang Hwa Bank Jiancheng Branch (彰化銀行建城/建成分行 B4–20F) 3D Modeling, Animation Video & BIM Auditing
projects.location: Taipei, Taiwan (Principal Architect: Chang Kuo-Chang 張國章建築師)
projects.area: Chang Hwa Bank Jiancheng Branch (B4–20F) & BIM Practice
projects.summary: Professional architectural practice at Taipei International Architecture Firm (台北國際聯合建築師事務所). Participated directly in the Chang Hwa Bank Jiancheng Branch / Building Redevelopment Project (彰化銀行建城/建成分行危老重建大樓案, B4–20F SC Green Smart Office Tower), executing Autodesk Revit 3D BIM modeling, model quality/clash auditing, 3D rendering and walkthrough animation video production (影片製作與3D建模), and competition proposal reports — earning the highest Top 5% recommendation from Principal Architect Chang Kuo-Chang.

details.concept: Key project participation in the Chang Hwa Bank Jiancheng Branch Redevelopment (彰化銀行建城/建成分行大樓興建案 — 地上20層、地下4層鋼骨綠色低碳智慧辦公大樓): responsible for 3D architectural modeling, Revit BIM model auditing, and architectural animation video production (影片製作與建模), alongside graduate BIM-to-BEM interoperability automation at NTUST.
details.materials: Autodesk Revit (ACU Certified), Revit API (Python), Twinmotion / Lumion 3D Animation Video Production, AutoCAD, EnergyPlus, gbXML Validation.
details.awards: Chang Hwa Bank Jiancheng Branch (彰化銀行建城分行) 3D Modeling & Animation Video Production | Strongly Recommended (Top 5%) by Principal Architect Chang Kuo-Chang (張國章主持建築師極力推薦)

projects.title: COLOR AND LIGHT (GERMANY): Origami Gradient Color & Tectonics
projects.subtitle: Hochschule München (HM) Exchange Studio — Chromatic Daylight & Spatial Color Theory
projects.summary: Developed during the 2024–2025 visiting exchange at Hochschule München (HM) in Germany. This late-stage design research investigates architectural Color Theory (色彩學) and Light Refraction through pleated origami construction louvers, translucent CMYK/RGB color-gradient matrices, and high-contrast yellow/red/green spatial staircase compositions, complemented by European architectural field photography and post-exchange lectures.

details.concept: Synthesizing German architectural color theory (Farbenlehre) with pleated origami surface tectonics. By layering rhythmic vertical folds with translucent chromatic bands and bold primary/complementary staircase planes, the study demonstrates how incident daylight transforms static circulation cores into dynamic perceptual gradients.
details.materials: Folded tectonic relief panels, dichromatic color filter matrices, architectural photography across Germany/Spain/Italy/Czechia, parametric daylight studies.
details.awards: Visiting Exchange Scholarship • Hochschule München (HM), Germany (2024–2025) • Post-Exchange Cultural Lecture Speaker (2025)

projects.title: Mr. Chi MAOAO Restaurant & Coast Bar (阿吉師卯澳餐廳)
projects.subtitle: Urban Heat Island (UHI) Inside Taipei & Autodesk Forma Microclimate Analysis
projects.summary: Practical thesis investigation on Urban Heat Island (UHI) mitigation along the coastal landscape (Advisor: Dr. Lucky S.J. Tsaih). Integrating thermal imaging observation before and after direct sunrise with Autodesk Forma early-stage solar radiation, wind corridor, and microclimate comfort simulations.

details.concept: Analyzing thermal radiation stark contrast between exposed coastal rock surfaces (34.1°C) and shaded vegetative/water zones (<28.9°C). Autodesk Forma Sun Hours (6/21 vs 12/21) and Wind Analysis guided the high-albedo white landform roof curvature to shelter visitors while channeling natural south-north sea breezes.
details.materials: High-albedo white roof membranes, local basalt aggregate concrete, low-E operable double glazing, coastal wind-adaptive landscaping.
details.awards: Special Topics on Professional Practices: Urban Heat Island Inside Taipei (Advisor: Dr. Lucky S.J. Tsaih 蔡欣君副教授極力推薦)

items.title: TAC: Temporary Art Performance Space in Sharjah
items.subtitle: OISTAT International Theatre Architecture Competition (UAE)
items.location: Bait Al Obaid Shamsi, Sharjah, UAE
items.summary: Late-stage 2025 international competition entry for OISTAT Theatre Architecture Competition (TAC) in Sharjah's Souk Al Bahar heritage district. Designed a rapid-assembly (<3 days) modular performance venue and tensile shading canopy inside the historic Bait Al Obaid Shamsi courtyard.

details.concept: Respecting the historic Coral-stone fabric of Bait Al Obaid Shamsi Courtyard while deploying a lightweight multi-layered tensile canopy and reconfigurable stage pods that host music, drama, and cultural festivals from October to April.
details.materials: Lightweight PTFE tensile shading sails, rapid-lock sustainable timber stage modules, breathable courtyard acoustic screens.
details.awards: 2025 OISTAT TAC International Competition Entry • Highlighted in Thesis Advisor Dr. Meng-Ting Tsai's Recommendation Letter

items.title: 2025 NTUST Graduation Exhibition & TTDA FabLab
items.subtitle: Graduation Design Showcase (June 2025) & Digital Fabrication Lab
items.summary: Presented comprehensive architectural thesis boards and physical tectonic models at the June 2025 NTUST Architecture Graduation Exhibition, building upon years as Core Manager of the TTDA 3D Printing & Laser-Cutting Lab.

details.concept: Bridging digital parametric modeling with high-precision physical fabrication (multi-material FDM/SLA 3D printing and laser-cut contour models) and public architectural communication at the 2025 Graduation Exhibition.
details.materials: Laser-cut basswood & museum board, SLA resin & PLA 3D-printed structural nodes, full-scale exhibition boards.
details.awards: 2025 NTUST Architecture Graduation Exhibition Exhibitor • NTUST TTDA FabLab Core Manager

items.title: NTUST Hsinchu Campus Design (台科大新竹校區 NDCC)
items.subtitle: Sunshine Analysis & Solar-Responsive Academic Courtyard
items.summary: Comprehensive university campus architecture design driven by 10:00 vs. 14:00 solar trajectory (Sunshine Analysis) massing studies, interlocking green courtyards, and glazed double-height studio commons.

details.concept: Using solar shadow casting at 10:00 and 14:00 to carve self-shaded academic courtyards and elevated skywalk bridges that connect studio wings, lecture halls, and tree-lined outdoor plazas.
details.materials: Fair-faced architectural concrete, low-E curtain wall glazing, timber acoustic ceilings, permeable courtyard landscaping.
details.awards: NTUST Architectural Design Studio Project NDCC (2023)

projects.title: Zhongshan CURVED Youth Hostel (中山青年旅舍設計)
projects.subtitle: Wave-form Cantilevered Balconies & 7-Story Urban Hospitality
projects.summary: A 7-story urban boutique youth hostel (Project 113) defined by sculptural, wave-like white cantilevered balconies and curved glass balustrades that generate dynamic street rhythms. Includes complete B1 parking/service, 1F–2F public courtyard cafe & lounge, 3F–6F modular bunk & suite layouts, and rooftop garden.

details.concept: The continuous sinuous floorplates serve as passive solar sunshades for the guest rooms while creating fluid indoor-outdoor pocket terraces overlooking Zhongshan's tree-lined avenues.
details.materials: Architectural fair-faced white concrete, curved steel balcony railings, custom modular timber bunk joinery, interior green atrium.

items.title: Jingmei VOUTE: Gallery & Bistro (景美藝廊複合餐酒館)
items.subtitle: 5-Story Masonry Arch Atrium, Floating Spherical Installations & Rooftop Sky Bar
items.summary: Vertical cultural composite integrating 1FL Cultural & Creative Shop, 2FL Art Gallery, 3FL–4FL Double/Triple-Height Vaulted Red-Brick Atrium with suspended spherical woven installations, 5FL Bistro, and RFL Rooftop Sky Bar.

details.concept: Stacking public-to-intimate cultural programs vertically while carving a dramatic multi-story red-brick arched atrium hung with floating spherical woven luminaires that draw daylight deep into the 2FL–4FL gallery levels.
details.materials: Hand-laid red clay masonry arches, translucent spherical woven fiber installations, warm travertine stone, white steel mezzanine bridges, rooftop sky bar.

items.title: Gulin Garden Parent-Child Center (牯嶺街親子中心)
items.subtitle: Interlocking Cylindrical Volumes, Grey Brickwork & Timber Louvers
items.summary: An organic community family center composed of three interlocking cylindrical pavilions wrapped in grey masonry brick, vertical timber louvers, and diamond-mesh rooftop safety balustrades.

details.concept: Replacing rigid institutional corridors with three looping cylindrical volumes that embrace pocket trees, sunken amphitheaters, curved reading tables, and an elevated rooftop play promenade.
details.materials: Grey masonry brickwork (灰色磚石), warm vertical timber louvers (木質柵欄), diamond wire-mesh railings (網格扶手).
details.awards: NTUST Urban Community Architecture Studio (GULIN GARDEN 2023)

items.title: BIM-to-BEM Interoperability & EnergyPlus Calibration
items.subtitle: Automated gbXML Thermal Validation & NSGA-II Optimization
items.summary: Graduate research resolving geometric distortion and thermal zoning disconnects between Autodesk Revit and EnergyPlus, slashing topological error below 5% and achieving 15%–25% energy savings.

details.concept: Scripting automated Revit API analytical space boundaries to resolve non-manifold surface geometry prior to EnergyPlus simulation and NSGA-II multi-objective daylight/thermal optimization.
details.materials: Autodesk Revit API, EnergyPlus, Python, gbXML Schema, NSGA-II Multi-Objective Genetic Algorithm.
details.awards: 15%–25% Simulated Building Energy Savings | Benchmarked to LEED EAc2 & Taiwan BERS
